site_name: 206 Moselle Avenue, Wood Green, London, N22 6EX
description:
Replacing the existing windows and rear kitchen exit door because of their poor condition and failure to meet the residents’ current needs. The existing timber windows are deteriorated and contribute to heat loss, condensation, security concerns, and related defects. All existing windows will therefore be removed and replaced.

At the front elevation, including the second-floor attic lightwell, new slimline double-glazed timber windows will be installed to match the property’s existing appearance. At the rear, new double-glazed uPVC casement windows will be installed. The rear kitchen exit door will also be replaced, as it is in poor condition and contributes to heat loss, condensation, and other related defects.

These works will improve thermal performance, enhance security, and increase comfort for the residents.
